in_sanskrit.name: Bhadrak
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Blessing, Auspicious
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bhadrak एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bhadra' meaning 'auspicious', 'Bhadrak' is a name that signifies blessings and good fortune. In Hindu mythology, 'Bhadrak' is also the name of a demon, Bhadrakalpamsha, who is believed to bring prosperity and wealth. The name is deeply rooted in Hindu culture and tradition.
